    public abstract class Signal internal constructor() {
        /** Unknown is a member this build does not know, holding the object that arrived. */

        }

        internal object Serializer : kotlinx.serialization.KSerializer<RestSchema.Signal> {
            override val descriptor: kotlinx.serialization.descriptors.SerialDescriptor =
                kotlinx.serialization.descriptors.buildClassSerialDescriptor("com.mountaya.client.generated.RestSchema.Signal")

            override fun serialize(
                encoder: kotlinx.serialization.encoding.Encoder,
                value: RestSchema.Signal,
            ) {
                when (value) {
                    is RestSchema.PingSignal -> encoder.encodeSerializableValue(RestSchema.PingSignal.serializer(), value)
                    is RestSchema.Signal.Unknown -> encoder.encodeSerializableValue(kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject.serializer(), value.json)
                    else -> throw kotlinx.serialization.SerializationException("RestSchema.Signal has no member of this class.")
                }
            }

            override fun deserialize(decoder: kotlinx.serialization.encoding.Decoder): RestSchema.Signal {
                val input =
                    decoder as? kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonDecoder
                        ?: throw kotlinx.serialization.SerializationException("RestSchema.Signal is read from JSON only.")

                    input.decodeJsonElement() as? kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
                        ?: throw kotlinx.serialization.SerializationException("RestSchema.Signal is a JSON object.")

                    else -> RestSchema.Signal.Unknown(json)
                }
